title: Vibrissa Config
description: Vibrissa config (vibrissa.json, vibrissa.jsonc, or package.json#vibrissa). Strings support ${ENV_VAR} and ${ENV_VAR:-fallback} interpolation. Precedence: defaults, then this file, then the selected profile, then CLI flags.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema (for editor completion).

servers.description: Named servers under test. Cases pick one with "server"; otherwise defaultServer is used.

defaultServer.description: Key into servers used when a case names no server. Default: "default", or the only server.

globs.description: Case file globs relative to the config file. Prefix with ! to exclude. Default ["tests/integration/**/*.json"].

manifestIgnore.description: Dotted manifest paths ignored when diffing against the lock (e.g. "tools.*.description"). Default ["server.version", "protocolVersion", "listMeta"]: release and protocol-era noise, so one lock serves both eras. `vib manifest diff --strict` compares everything.

requireManifest.description: Fail the run when a server's manifest lock file is missing (instead of warning). Turn it on in CI so an unrecorded surface cannot pass silently. Default false.

outDir.description: Directory for reporter artifacts (junit.xml, results.json, traces/), relative to the config file. Default "reports".

budgetMs.description: Default latency budget per case/step in ms; slower fails.

failFast.description: Stop at the first failing case. Default false.

allowEmpty.description: If true, matching zero case files exits 0. Default false (fail loud).

reporters.description: Reporters to run: console, json, junit, github, tap. Default ["console"].

tags.description: Run only cases carrying at least one of these tags.

excludeTags.description: Skip cases carrying any of these tags.

grep.description: Run only cases whose name matches this regular expression.

repeat.description: Run every case N times and report pass rates (flake detection).

concurrency.description: Parallel workers (one server session each). Default 1.

update.description: Rewrite failing goldens from live output (like jest -u).

trace.description: Write JSON-RPC transcripts for every case, not only failures.

check.description: Also run spec-sanity checks and description lint.

baseline.description: Previous results file; fail only on regressions against it.

profiles.description: Named overlays merged over the base config with --profile <name>.

additionalProperties.description: A profile: any config key except profiles; servers entries patch the base by name.

servers.description: Per-server overrides, merged into the base servers by name.

defaultServer.description: Key into servers used when a case names no server. Default: "default", or the only server.

globs.description: Case file globs relative to the config file. Prefix with ! to exclude. Default ["tests/integration/**/*.json"].

manifestIgnore.description: Dotted manifest paths ignored when diffing against the lock (e.g. "tools.*.description"). Default ["server.version", "protocolVersion", "listMeta"]: release and protocol-era noise, so one lock serves both eras. `vib manifest diff --strict` compares everything.

requireManifest.description: Fail the run when a server's manifest lock file is missing (instead of warning). Turn it on in CI so an unrecorded surface cannot pass silently. Default false.

outDir.description: Directory for reporter artifacts (junit.xml, results.json, traces/), relative to the config file. Default "reports".

budgetMs.description: Default latency budget per case/step in ms; slower fails.

failFast.description: Stop at the first failing case. Default false.

allowEmpty.description: If true, matching zero case files exits 0. Default false (fail loud).

reporters.description: Reporters to run: console, json, junit, github, tap. Default ["console"].

tags.description: Run only cases carrying at least one of these tags.

excludeTags.description: Skip cases carrying any of these tags.

grep.description: Run only cases whose name matches this regular expression.

repeat.description: Run every case N times and report pass rates (flake detection).

concurrency.description: Parallel workers (one server session each). Default 1.

update.description: Rewrite failing goldens from live output (like jest -u).

trace.description: Write JSON-RPC transcripts for every case, not only failures.

check.description: Also run spec-sanity checks and description lint.

baseline.description: Previous results file; fail only on regressions against it.

protocol.description: Protocol era negotiation. "auto" (default) probes server/discover and falls back to the 2025 initialize handshake; "legacy" forces the 2025 handshake; "modern" requires the 2026-07-28 era; a revision string or { "pin": "<revision>" } requires exactly that revision.

pin.description: Exact protocol revision to require, e.g. "2026-07-28".

stdioServer.description: A server spawned as a child process and spoken to over stdio.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process, relative to the config file.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process (merged over the current environment).

spawnTimeoutMs.description: Max time (ms) to spawn/connect and finish the handshake. Default: timeoutMs clamped to 2000..10000.

httpServer.description: A server reached over the Streamable HTTP transport.

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint, e.g. "https://mcp.example.com/mcp" (may use ${ENV} interpolation).

headers.description: Static HTTP headers sent on every request, e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer ${MCP_TOKEN}" }.

spawnTimeoutMs.description: Max time (ms) to spawn/connect and finish the handshake. Default: timeoutMs clamped to 2000..10000.

server.description: A server under test: { "cmd": ... } for stdio or { "url": ... } for Streamable HTTP.

serverPatch.description: Profile override for a named server. Include cmd or url to replace the entry; otherwise the listed fields patch the base entry.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process, relative to the config file.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process (merged over the current environment).

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint, e.g. "https://mcp.example.com/mcp" (may use ${ENV} interpolation).

headers.description: Static HTTP headers sent on every request, e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer ${MCP_TOKEN}" }.

spawnTimeoutMs.description: Max time (ms) to spawn/connect and finish the handshake. Default: timeoutMs clamped to 2000..10000.

normalize.description: Result envelope normalization applied before matching and recording.

stripMeta.description: Glob-ish keys to strip from every _meta object. Default ["io.modelcontextprotocol/*"].

dropKeys.description: Top-level result keys to drop. Default ["resultType"].

ttlMs.description: Whether list results keep their ttlMs/cacheScope cache hints. Default "ignore".

shard.description: Run only one shard of the suite: "<index>/<total>" (1-based) or { "index", "total" }.

checks.description: Tuning for spec-sanity checks and description lint (vib check, vib run --check). Profiles extend allow and merge severity.

severity.description: Per-check severity override: check id -> "failed" (fails the run) or "warned" (reported only).

hooks.description: Suite-level steps run once per server session.

setup.description: Steps run before the first case (step shape: case.schema.json#/$defs/step).

teardown.description: Steps run after the last case, even on failure (step shape: case.schema.json#/$defs/step).
